text:
olivia: URGENT — post-embargo correction. We shipped the blog 60m ago and a benchmark table had a mislabeled row. Headline number unaffected but one callout line is wrong. Need press ops + short correction language ASAP.
rachel: Thanks for flagging. Can you paste the exact line that changed? We need a 2-sentence correction and a preferred subject line for reporters.
olivia: The line in question: "Median latency for long-context reranking: 42ms" should be "Median latency for long-context reranking: 52ms". Headline aggregate unchanged.
ben: Legal recommends a concise correction + offer to share corrected chart and methodology. Avoid absolutes and don't speculate on causes in public note. Suggest: 
```
Correction (published): An earlier version of our benchmark blog misstated the median latency for long-context reranking. The correct figure is 52ms. We have updated the blog and the corrected chart is available in the press pack. For raw data requests, please contact press@redwood with NDA.
```
pressbot: Outreach already sent to tier-1 at 09:00 PT. I can send a correction note to the same list at 10:05 PT if you confirm text.
kate: Social ops: pause paid amplification and scheduled posts that rely on the specific 42ms line. We'll post an update thread once correction language is cleared. Suggest pinned correction tweet with link to corrected chart.
tom: Ops note: site updated with corrected table, cache purge completed at 09:40 PT. No infra impact.
alex: I'm ok to sign the short correction if you want CEO attribution. Prefer to keep it factual and brief.
rachel: Draft subject lines: "Correction: Redwood benchmark update" OR "Update: corrected latency figure in Redwood benchmark". Which do we prefer?
olivia: Use the first one: "Correction: Redwood benchmark update". For the body, use Ben's suggested text but add one sentence offering interviews if reporters want deeper context.
ben: Fine with that addition. Keep interview offer optional and route requests to legal.
pressbot: Ready to send correction at 10:05 PT to the original outreach list. Confirm send with :thumbsup:.
kate: I'll prepare social copy and hold paid until we post the correction update (target +15m after send).
rachel: I'll draft the email and put it in the press pack under /corrections/correction_1999991111.txt. Will ping once queued.
olivia: Queue send. Pressbot, send at 10:05 PT. Please include the corrected chart link in the email and note that raw data requires NDA.
pressbot: Scheduled: correction_send at 2026-09-10T17:05:00Z (10:05 PT). Recipients: tier-1 + partners list.
tom: I'll post a 1-line ops update in #eng-oncall at T-5 minutes.
ekate: :thumbsup:
ben: :thumbsup:
rachel: :thumbsup:
pressbot: Reminder will fire at 10:00 PT.
olivia: Thank you team. Keep any reporter replies or escalations in this thread and tag me if anything unusual comes up.
